author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art: gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration. Book is lighter fantasy but wants art that feels grounded and lifelike. Open to different styles; share work/recs. Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. For the map: detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel; open stylistically. Visual world; excited to describe it. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites. No budget stated. Thread still receiving artist replies as of fetch; no close notice.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. Looking for artists that draw: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if interested or DM directly. Follow-up from author: thanks for reaching out, surprised by interest, will check portfolios; if you have not sent a portfolio, provide a link to previous works. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k. No budget stated. Still collecting portfolios; not marked closed.
